## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
Sector Rotation / Neutral. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%) while XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%); VXX falling (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND confirms lower fear but Credit Spread rising (Level 0.7296, 1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.60%) ↑ ABOVE TREND signals credit tension.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: Credit Spread (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.60%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +1.18%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.64%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: SPY/TLT Level 7.7250 (1W: -0.78% | 1M: +3.02%) → flat TREND EXHAUSTION and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -1.01%) as Yield Curve (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -1.47%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Dollar (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -0.99%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals leading on a rotation: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.62%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +5.32%); Tech lagging with XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%). Style mixed / no clear leadership given breadth at 6/11.

5. US vs Global?  
US in short-term pullback: SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.98%). EM and China weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.92% | 1M: -2.45%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -4.31%), while Europe showing relative improvement (Europe vs US 1W: +1.82% | 1M: +1.70% ↑ rising ABOVE TREND).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative flows softening: ARKK in CORRECTION (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +6.16%), IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +7.36%), and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -4.59%) shows crypto weakness.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals strong: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +26.96%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +6.52%); base metals mixed with CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +6.41%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy weak across the board: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -3.01%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -5.98% | 1M: -7.26%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -15.15% | 1M: -14.31%) — downside pressure remains.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%) and several cyclicals showing both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE (minor): SPY and XLK showing TREND EXHAUSTION → both in CORRECTION (SPY 1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.98%; XLK 1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%), so monitor momentum for continuation or reversal.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/financial exposure (XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%) ABOVE TREND, XLY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.62%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to stretched Tech (XLK (1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%) CORRECTION) and Energy (XLE (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit spreads and IBIT for risk-off signals.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%), XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.62%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +5.32%).  
BEARISH: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%), XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -3.01%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +26.96%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +6.52%).  
BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -15.15% | 1M: -14.31%), USO / BNO BELOW TREND (BNO 1W: -5.98% | 1M: -7.26%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), Credit Spread ~0.73 (current 0.7296), SPY/TLT ~7.7 (current 1W: -0.78% | 1M: +3.02%) for risk vs safety tension, XLK/XLF tech vs financial ratio ~2.61 (current 1W: -5.46% | 1M: -5.35%) as leadership pivot.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Sector Rotation / Neutral with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and VXX falling (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND. Cyclicals/Financials showing relative strength (XLF ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.39% | 1M: +6.20%; XLY ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.62%). Key risk is rising credit stress and minor divergence as SPY and XLK are in CORRECTION (SPY 1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.98%; XLK 1W: -4.15% | 1M: +0.52%) — monitor spreads and IBIT.
